title: Cayley-transform analysis and numerical validation of the convergent Born series for the Helmholtz equation
summary: We develop an operator-theoretic framework for the Convergent Born Series (CBS) method applied to the Lippmann--Schwinger equation for high-frequency Helmholtz problems. In contrast to the Fourier-based analysis of Osnabrugge et al., our approach expresses the preconditioned Lippmann--Schwinger iteration entirely in terms of the resolvent of a self-adjoint background operator.
